messages:
nina: Heads-up - planning a staged feature flag rollout for router-service change in the 23:00 UTC change window. Trying a slower early ramp to observe cold-cache and route-priority behavior.

paul: Proposed schedule?

nina: Deploy with FF off. Then: 0.5% @+10m, 2% @+25m, 25% @+50m, 100% @+90m. If anything anomalous, rollback and pin routing to router-v3.

rahul: Guardrails: svc_error_rate > 1.0% for 3m, p99 latency delta > 200ms, or increased 5xx logs by >250% -> stop and rollback. Also if EC2 queue depth > 100 for 5m.

paul: Can deploy-bot do fractional steps like 0.5%? We used half-percent earlier but it was manual.

deploy-bot: scheduled: toggle_id=tb-6480023456-A; flag=router_priority_v3; schedule=[+10m->0.5%,+25m->2%,+50m->25%,+90m->100%]; pause_on_alert=alerts.router_*; rollback_triggers=[error_rate>1.0,p99_delta>200ms,queue>100]; sticky_cohort=internal-team; initiator=nina

diane: I'll prep a router pin as well: pin_id=pin-6480023456-eu-west-router -> target=router-v2; TTL=48h. ops-oncall, can you stage it so we can flip instantly?

ops-oncall: staging pin now. pin will be applied automatically on rollback command. kill command is `deploy-bot rollback tb-6480023456-A`.

smoke-bot: smoke test script is `ci/smoke/router_basic.sh`. Will run once after deploy and after each ramp step against internal cohort. Results posted here.

nina: Release note blurb to add to PR: "Staged routing toggle to validate cold-path routing and cache priming; conservative early steps and automatic pause on infra alerts."

paul: Also include deploy command in notes for ops: `~/bin/deploy --svc=router --image=router:v3 --ff=router_priority_v3=off --change-window=23:00`

rahul: Suggest adding an explicit soak check after the 2% step for 20m before moving to 25%. Small traffic might hide a slow-fail.

nina: good call. updating schedule: +10m 0.5% -> +25m 2% -> soak +20m -> +50m 25% -> +90m 100%. deploy-bot updated.

deploy-bot: toggle tb-6480023456-A updated: soak_after=2%:20m; manual_confirm_on_pause=true

paul: I'm adding a note to oncall runbook: If rollout pauses on alerts, do not resume until infra and app owners approve. Collect top traces and the route decision logs.

ops-oncall: I've also added a temporary dashboard with: p50/p95/p99, 5xx counts by backend, queue depth, and router decision rates. Link will be posted when live.

nina: Standby from 22:40 UTC. I'll trigger deploy at 23:00.

(23:00 UTC - nina posts)

```
Deploy starting: router-service v3
Image: ghcr.redwood/router:v3
FF router_priority_v3=OFF
Instances: 8 -> 8
Healthchecks: green
Change window: 23:00-01:00 UTC
```

smoke-bot: initial smoke: internal routes OK, 0 failures. p99 baseline 340ms.

deploy-bot: toggle to 0.5% executed @23:10. cohort=internal-team + sampled 0.5% of traffic.

smoke-bot: post-step smoke @23:15: OK. p99 = 355ms (+15ms). 5xx count unchanged.

rahul: monitoring dashboard looks normal. queue depth small. proceeding to 2% at +25.

deploy-bot: toggle to 2% executed @23:25.

smoke-bot: post-step smoke @23:30: a few transient 502s on route /aggregate at 23:27 (3 occurrences). p99 = 420ms (+80ms).

paul: I see the 502s correlated with backend worker restarts in eu-west. Ops, any infra events?

ops-oncall: no scheduled infra maintenance. I'm seeing a GC spike on router-worker-3 around 23:26. Investigating.

nina: because p99 delta hit 80ms but under threshold 200ms, and 5xx is low, should we hold and let soak complete? We planned a soak for 20m.

rahul: hold. if we see repeated 5xx or p99 >200ms we should pause. For now, watch for pattern.

deploy-bot: soak timer running: 20m from 23:25 -> will not auto-progress until soak completes or manual override.

(23:33)
paul: additional 502s at 23:31 (2 more). total 5xx in 10m up 180% vs baseline. still below rollback threshold but trending up.

ops-oncall: GC showed multiple long-pauses. increasing routing queue temporarily. marking infra alert candidate.

deploy-bot: alert infra.router_gc detected -> pause rollout. awaiting manual_confirm_on_pause.

nina: pausing rollout. please gather traces 23:20-23:35 and top slow stacks.

rahul: I pulled traces - root cause looks like a lock contention during neighbor-table rebuild when route table size hits threshold. Seems v3 changes increased table rebuild frequency.

paul: ops, can we mitigate by bumping route table rebuild backoff? Might be a quick config toggle.

ops-oncall: temp config adjust applied to reduce rebuild concurrency on router-worker group. watching effects.

smoke-bot: re-run smoke against internal cohort @23:42: no new 502s in last 10m. p99 back to 360ms.

nina: given fix and smoke green, decision: abort automatic resume. we will re-run a controlled 2% -> 25% next midnight after config hardened. For this window, do rollback and pin to router-v2.

paul: agree. initiate rollback.

deploy-bot: rollback command received: `deploy-bot rollback tb-6480023456-A` executed @23:45. flag router_priority_v3=OFF; apply pin pin-6480023456-eu-west-router.

ops-oncall: pin applied and verified. traffic returned to router-v2.

smoke-bot: post-rollback checks OK. p99 baseline restored.

nina: adding to release notes: "23:00 staged toggle paused due to GC-induced p99 spikes during route-table rebuild; rollback executed and routing pinned to v2. Config tweak applied and follow-up ticket created (#3314)."

rahul: retrospective: start at 0.1% for complex routing changes next time, and add small config flag to toggle rebuild concurrency without full deploy.

paul: I'll document the config hotfix path in runbook.

deploy-bot: tb-6480023456-A closed: reason=manual rollback; closed_by=paul; closed_at=6480023700

nina: thanks everyone. follow-up ticket #3314 with traces, dashboards, and proposed config change. We'll reschedule after validation.
